A '''town''' was located north of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was destroyed by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] during their [[invasion of Spinnaker]], and [[Camp 14]] was established near its ruins.<ref name="GB" />

==Description==
A trading town loyal to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was positioned on the edge of a [[Water/Legends|bay]] opposite the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], which would send [[Royal trade ship]]s to collect valuable [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from the town. The town itself had a rectangular shape with another square section jutting out to the southwest over the water. The surface of the town was paved with bricks and the edges were covered with guardrails. The town was accessible by water from the southwest, with the entrance consisting of an open archway guarded by a [[Turret/Legends|turret]]. The northeast portion of the town was bordered by [[prefab shelter]]s, with two [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] in the middle section and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] in between them. A turret and a [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry post]] were adjacent to each of the spaceports. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] built a [[Prison/Legends|prison camp]], [[Camp 14]], besides the town on its northeastern side.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when the invaded Naboo, the company [[Invasion of Spinnaker|attacked]] Spinnaker for its stockpiles of nova crystals.<ref name="GB" /> Afterward, the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] targeted the town to the northeast, loading an [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummel]] into a transport and sent it to the town. The pummel destroyed the turrets, allowing the Trade Federation to send [[Neimoidian trader]]s to collect nova crystals from the town's spaceports.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo town was created for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> Prior to its appearance in the game, the base was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> released [[November 7|four days]] earlier.<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> An image included in the [[Prima Games]] guide shows the town without the guardrails<ref name="Prima" /> that are present in the game.<ref name="GB" />

The town first appears in the third level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Spinnaker's Spoils," in which it appears as an enemy team labelled "Naboo Traders." The player can trade for nova crystals at the town's spaceports if they clear out its defenses,<ref name="GB" /> a path recommended by the strategy guide.<ref name="Prima" />
